test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F were six friends playing games around a circular table. They were standing facing the centre of the table. E was standing to the immediate left of A. C was second to the left of F. There were exactly two people between D and A. B was at the immediate right of A. Which friend was at the immediate right of F?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• A, B, C, D, E and F were six friends playing games around a circular table. 
 
• They were standing facing the centre of the table.

(1.) E was standing to the immediate left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cdf0a7c1c1c4c258f6f1d21e63cb06051f26259bfa52f9c95544251ee3f647a.png] 

(2.) B was at the immediate right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da8e6d84309caf7e4ca43ae32dc759ec32d862a663554bb59badec901b3c4614.png] 

 (3.) C was second to the left of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7185ec3edf49981675b18ae63d5b3a181e3d88facfdf542fc497173084ddb09.png] 

 (4.) There were exactly two people between D and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9cc89e9c198c6ce8b733137118ddbd16a768573f14e79289b36a5cf48698188.png] 

Now, it is clearly shown that E is immediately right to F.

Hence, the correct answer is **E**.
